summary: Expose guarded stack deployment through Hermes
description: Extend the Hermes command contract so one operator instruction can request preflight, plan, approval, bootstrap, startup, and verification without leaking deployment internals.
acceptance: Natural-language install/start intents map to deterministic preflight, plan, approval, apply, and verify operations with explicit target-host and authority boundaries.
The command pauses only for real missing choices, credentials, destructive authority, or approval of the exact deployment plan; ordinary discovery and verification continue autonomously.
Progress and final Telegram output remain concise, redacted, evidence-backed, and distinguish installed, started, healthy, blocked, rolled back, and unverified states.
A synthetic command proof reaches a healthy stack and proves stale-plan, unauthorized-host, and destructive-action denial.
